# dash0_signal_to_metrics (Resource)

Manages a Dash0 Signal-to-Metrics rule. A signal-to-metrics rule turns the spans or logs that match its filter into metric data points at ingestion: it counts them, or records a number taken from each one as a sum, gauge, or exponential histogram. See [Convert Signals to Metrics](https://dash0.com/docs/dash0/telemetry/signal-control/convert-signals-to-metrics) for the rule fields and their limits.

~> **Note:** `spec.enabled` is required. The provider always sends a value for it, so an omitted field would silently create a disabled rule and later switch off one enabled elsewhere.

Deletes are soft: a destroyed rule stops producing metrics, and the API keeps a tombstone of it. Changing `dataset` destroys the rule and re-creates it under a new origin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dash0_signal_to_metrics" "checkout_errors" {
  dataset                = "default"
  signal_to_metrics_yaml = file("${path.module}/signal_to_metrics.yaml")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `signal_to_metrics_yaml` (String) The signal-to-metrics rule definition in YAML format. The YAML must declare `kind: Dash0SignalToMetrics`, an explicit `spec.enabled`, `spec.match` (the source signal and its filters), and `spec.output` (the metric name and interval). `spec.targetDatasetMode: original` is the default and is treated as equal to an omitted field. `metadata.labels` and `metadata.annotations` are server-managed and ignored, and `metadata.labels.custom` is rejected because signal-to-metrics rules have no custom labels.

### Optional

- `dataset` (String) The identifier of the [Dash0 dataset](https://dash0.com/docs/dash0/miscellaneous/glossary/datasets) that the signal-to-metrics rule belongs to. Provide the dataset's identifier, which is immutable, not the 'name'. Datasets are used to separate observability data within a Dash0 organization. If omitted, the provider-level `dataset` default is used (see the provider's `dataset` attribute). Changing this value forces the resource to be recreated under a new origin.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The server-assigned identifier of the signal-to-metrics rule, resolved by the provider after creation.
- `origin` (String) A unique identifier for the signal-to-metrics rule, automatically generated on creation. Used to reference the rule for updates, reads, deletes, and imports.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash
terraform import dash0_signal_to_metrics.checkout_errors default,tf_existing-signal-to-metrics-origin
```
